verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at cactuscompute.com. The vendor also publishes agent-oriented markdown subpages (/llms/api, /llms/pricing, /llms/run-locally) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /v1/openapi.json, and its docs explicitly name running the platform from 'a coding agent with your API key'. The probe's 404s are only for root-level OpenAPI paths and do not contradict the /v1 spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs successfully.
